title.narrative: JSC m2 Real Estate II (Ramada& AfH)

description.narrative: (i) Business Infrastructure Development: The Hotel Project will help alleviate the lack of modern business infrastructure, especially in the mid-market segment in Georgia by bringing the first 3 star branded international hotel to the country; (ii) Continue increasing supply of green, affordable and quality housing and a hotel: M2RE has helped pioneer the establishment of sustainable real estate development in Georgia with the first affordable housing project IFC financed in 2013. (iii)Job Creation: The Hotel Project will create additional direct and indirect employment during construction and operational phases. Affordable housing project will create additional indirect employment during the construction phases. (iv) Enhanced Upstream and Downstream Local Supply Linkages with MSMEs: The Hotel Project will contribute to the development of the local economy by facilitating linkages with MSME vendors that will serve the needs of both the hotel and their guests. The AfH project will increase the demand for construction and building material. (v) Increased Tax Revenue: Both Projects will increase tax revenues for the country, states, and local municipalities; (vi) Community development: The housing developments will contribute to the renovation and expansion of urban infrastructure and surrounding community development, including the construction and rehabilitation of roads, electricity, water access and sanitation serving the developments. (vii) Demonstration effect: Affordable housing project will have the strong demonstration effect by fostering competition in the housing sector in Georgia and restoring credibility. In addition, the project with its standard for green buildings is helping raise the level of awareness of the economic benefits of green building, therefore increasing demand and inducing other developers to follow suit.

The Project consists of providing a corporate loan facility for the development of low to middle income housing (AfH) projects and a project finance for the development of a 152 room Ramada Encore hotel investment (together the Projects), in Georgia sponsored by JSC m2 Real Estate (M2RE, the Sponsor), directly and indirectly 100% owned by Bank of Georgia Holdings Plc (BoG).
